title: Bullet-distributed DeepMimic pretrained motor research
attribution: Bullet Physics contributors; DeepMimic research by Xue Bin Peng, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine and Michiel van de Panne. Local port evaluation and data-only NumPy adapter by Sollish. No new policy training in this experiment.
provenanceNote: Used Bullet-distributed checkpoint bytes. They are not byte-identical to the original XBPeng initial checkpoint. Repo-root zlib license applies to these paths; separate Extras/ThirdPartyLibs notices remain applicable to their code.

limitations: Research replay only; no combat opponent, live outcome or financial authority.
All three original quality gates fail on both default-240Hz records.
10-second free-base observations do not establish robustness.
Original DeepMimic MIT notice retained for attribution; it does not make two different checkpoint versions identical.
